reviews.comment:
De paso por el lugar, me cargaron combustible, limpiaron los vidrios, revisaron el agua, después de todo eso, no querían aceptar una atención, me dice el playero estamos para servirle al señor y en nuestro trabajo y deber!! No lo podía creer, gracias muchachos!!

(Translated by Google)
While I was passing by, they filled up my tank, cleaned the windows, checked the water, and after all that, they didn't want to accept any service. The attendant told me, "We're here to serve you, it's our job and our duty!" I couldn't believe it. Thanks, guys!
